name: Repeated authentication failures
description: Finds a burst of failed authentication events for the same recorded username and source IP.
logic: At least BLUEWATCH_FAILED_AUTH_THRESHOLD failures for one username and source IP within BLUEWATCH_FAILED_AUTH_WINDOW_MINUTES.
false_positive_limitations: Password managers, stale services, shared NAT addresses, and user mistakes can create bursts. Review host context and source provenance before assigning intent.

name: Authentication failures followed by success
description: Finds one or more failed authentication events followed by a success for the same recorded username and source IP.
logic: A successful authentication is preceded by one or more failures for the same username and source IP within BLUEWATCH_AUTH_SEQUENCE_WINDOW_MINUTES.
false_positive_limitations: A user correcting a mistyped password can produce this sequence. This is an investigative lead, not proof that credentials were abused.
